{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: M3-0.5 x 12mm (100 PCS) Socket Head Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 12.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Coarse Thread UNC, DIN 912; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small socket screws fit my projects, but I would verify the mixed metric/UNC thread description before choosing them.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: #6 x 1" Flat Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Self Drilling Screws with Self Tapping Screw Thread, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful for sheet metal fastening, but I would choose the assorted screw kit first for its range of lengths.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: FOLIV 265PCS Black Self Tapping Screws, 8 x 1/2” to 1-1/2” (410) Stainless Steel Modified Truss Head Sheet Metal Screws Assortment Kit, Black Oxide Self Drilling, 6 Different Length Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Multiple lengths and broad heads would be useful for fastening panels alongside my existing rivet and bolt supplies.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: VINTEX 4 Pack 3/4" Pex x 3/4" Pex Heavy Duty Ball Valve,3/4 Inch Pex x 3/4 Inch Pex Shut Off Valve, Brass with Stainless Steel Clamps Rings; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects do not indicate a need for 3/4 inch PEX plumbing valves.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Disposable gloves could help with messy work, but I would verify chemical compatibility and durability before using these with epoxy."}
